description: Defines the InAccessibleEntityIdOption class used for validation rules related to entity access control in the OrangeHRM system. Contains properties and methods for handling exception messages, permissions, roles, and throw behavior.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: Validation rule class for handling access restrictions on entities based on permissions and roles.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception object, creating a default ForbiddenException if none is set.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets the exception object to be used when validation fails.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message string.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Checks if the validation should throw an exception on failure.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether to throw an exception on validation failure.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Checks if validation should throw when only the entity exists.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Configures whether to throw if only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions required for access.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Sets the list of required permissions.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles to be excluded from access.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles to be included for access.
